variants.label: Carousel
variants.tooltip: Enables you to cycle through a selection of views at a defined rate.

schema.title: Carousel
schema.description: A component which displays one or more Views as slides in a loop, optionally in automated fashion.

viewPath.description: The path of the view to render in the carousel.
viewPath.title: View Path

viewParams.description: Parameters for the view. If passing parameters into the embedded view, the names here must match the parameters on that view.
viewParams.title: View Parameters

justify.description: Adjusts placement of view along the main axis.

alignItems.description: Adjusts placement of view along the cross axis.

lazyLoad.description: Load views on demand or progressively.

enabled.description: If true, the carousel will automatically scroll through the views according to the transitionDelay.

transitionDelay.title: Transition Delay
transitionDelay.description: Delay (in ms) at which slides scroll through the carousel when autoplay is true.

pauseOnDotHover.title: Pause on Dot Hover
pauseOnDotHover.description: Pause autoplay on dot mouse over.

behavior.title: Behavior
behavior.description: Behavior and interaction related carousel options.

transitionSpeed.title: Transition Speed
transitionSpeed.description: The speed (in ms) at which the carousel transitions between slides.

fade.title: Fade
fade.description: Enables slides to fade in and out of view on transition.

mobileSwipeable.title: Mobile Swipeable
mobileSwipeable.description: Enables swiping on mobile to change slides.

desktopDraggable.title: Desktop Draggable
desktopDraggable.description: Enables scrolling via drag on desktop.

swipeThreshold.title: Swipe threshold
swipeThreshold.description: The maximum length of a drag, in pixels, to allow before initiating a slide transition.  Minimum of 50 pixels. Actual threshold will be either the provided value, or half the width of the slide pane, whichever is smaller.

iconPath.description: Path to an icon that will be used if provided.

styles.title: Dot Styles
styles.description: Configure active and inactive styles for the dot icon.

active.description: Styles to apply when the dot icon is active.

fillColor.description: The active icon color or fill, enabled when the current slide's index matches the dot's index.

inactive.description: Styles to apply when the dot icon is inactive.

fillColor.description: The inactive icon color or fill, enabled when the current slide's index does not match the dot's index.

iconPath.description: Path to an icon that will be used for the next arrow if provided.

fillColor.description: Fill color to apply to icon.

iconPath.description: Path to an icon that will be used for the previous arrow if provided.

fillColor.description: Fill color to apply to icon.

useDefaultViewWidth.description: Enables the use of view default width instead of dynamically adjusting based on the available width.

useDefaultViewHeight.description: Enables the use of view default height instead of dynamically adjusting based on the available height.

slidesToShow.title: Slides to Show
slidesToShow.description: Number of slides to show on each carousel page.
